proposed_comments.title: Wait for maintainer architecture alignment
proposed_comments.reason: Do not duplicate the existing maintainer discussion.
proposed_comments.body: Thanks for the substantial implementation and validation work here. The remaining question is on the PowerToys side: we need to decide whether this command should use a shared shell-extension host and what Windows 10 behavior is required. No further action is requested from you until maintainers confirm that direction.

proposed_comments.title: Complete sparse-package and installer integration
proposed_comments.reason: Use only if maintainers retain the standalone implementation direction.
proposed_comments.body: The standalone package needs the integration fixes demonstrated on the review fork: stage only manifest/assets before MakeAppx, stamp the manifest version, sign the produced MSIX, use the installation root for sparse registration, point the COM server at WinUI3Apps, and ensure the installer generates and carries both context-menu DLLs plus the package.

proposed_comments.title: Harden Explorer command and clipboard behavior
proposed_comments.reason: Use only if maintainers retain the standalone implementation direction.
proposed_comments.body: Please harden the Explorer command before landing: accept exactly one filesystem selection, hide for existing UNC paths, honor okToBeSlow with E_PENDING, resolve a valid clipboard owner, allocate data before EmptyClipboard, transfer ownership only after SetClipboardData succeeds, and preserve cleanup on all failures.

proposed_comments.title: Align settings, policy, and platform support
proposed_comments.reason: Use only after maintainers define the supported architecture and OS behavior.
proposed_comments.body: The settings integration should include policy definitions, disable the card when GPO controls the utility, route the settings deep link, and avoid exposing a Windows 11-only command on Windows 10 unless a legacy handler is added.

proposed_comments.title: Remove unrelated scope and add verification
proposed_comments.reason: Use only if implementation work resumes.
proposed_comments.body: Please remove the unrelated Shortcut Guide resource and broad spell-check additions, add assertions for settings IPC, extend installation verification to require both Copy as UNC DLLs and the sparse MSIX, and add focused native coverage for direct UNC input, mapped-drive resolution, ERROR_MORE_DATA, and failure-before-clipboard behavior if implementation work resumes.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Corrected the fork PR description to document persistent registration while disabled. A later published registration-root finding was replied to and resolved as a false positive: get_module_folderpath() without an HINSTANCE resolves the PowerToys host executable directory, while the HINSTANCE overload is used only to locate the MSIX in WinUI3Apps.
